use_case_name: Browse and Search Files and Archives

claims.content: To allow users to browse, search, and gain access to files and archives on the computer system.

goal.raw_text: To allow users to browse, search, and gain access to files and archives on the computer system.

claims.content: The user opens the application and accesses the file manager interface.

trigger.raw_text: The user opens the application and accesses the file manager interface.

claims.content: The user opens the application, which displays the file manager interface.
The user browses the computer system's objects using navigation buttons (back, forward, up) or by selecting items from the 'Filesystem', 'Bookmarks', or 'Recent archives' menus.
To search for specific files, the user can use the recursive search function (F3) or non-recursive search (Ctrl+F3).
The user selects one or more files or archives from the displayed list.
The user can perform actions on the selected items, such as opening them, extracting their contents, or viewing their properties.
The user can use the 'Select' submenu to choose objects based on specific criteria such as type, attributes, date, size, or selection status.

Instead of selecting individual items, the user can select all objects ('Select all'), invert the current selection ('Invert selection'), or select all objects before the beginning of the function objects.
The user has successfully navigated to the desired directory or archive location within the file manager interface.
The user has located specific files or archives through browsing or search functions.
The selected files or archives are ready for subsequent actions such as opening, extracting, or viewing properties.
